_doc: Console card for showcase row 1b: the bridge call 01a_prospect_gui makes and the part of
its answer that names the iron vein. The command is the one trigger_bot.sh sends in that
shot, port and 30 s timeout included (bridge_ctl, which ./gerda ctl dispatches to). The response lines are bridge_ctl's
json.dumps(indent=2) print of the ext.js prospect reply, cut to its contiguous `veins`
block: with want "iron" the reply's veins holds only iron, as {x, z, dist, cells, bbox}.
(--set iron_x=... or `values`), never from a guess: the render refuses an unfilled token.
title: gerda — bridge 55545
